name: How much does it cost to upgrade the electrical panel for improved lighting safety?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to upgrade the electrical panel for improved lighting safety?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of an electrical panel upgrade varies depending on factors like the panel's amperage, the complexity of the existing wiring, and any necessary code compliance updates. Generally, you can expect costs to range from several hundred to a few thousand dollars. A professional electrician will provide a detailed estimate after assessing your home's specific needs. This investment enhances safety, supports modern appliance loads, and increases your home's value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for an electrical panel upgrade range from several hundred to a few thousand dollars, depending on amperage and complexity.
